problem:
$$
V=\text{Span}{[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 2 \\ 4\end{aligned}]},\,B={[\begin{aligned}-\frac{2\sqrt{2}}{3} \\ \frac{\sqrt{2}}{6} \\ \frac{\sqrt{2}}{6}\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}a \\ b \\ c\end{aligned}]}
$$

Consider the subspace $V$ and an **orthonormal** basis $B$ of $V,$ given above. Given that $B$ is derived from $V$ using the Gram-Schmidt process, what is the value of $|a|+|b|+|c|?$
